popup.title: Black Ash Plain
popup.description: A wasteland of black volcanic ash, home to [[brown dragon]]s and [[ash giant]]s.

popup.title: Plains of Purple Dust
popup.description: A windy desert located east of the [[Dragonsword Mountains]].

popup.title: Raurin
popup.description: The '''Dust Desert'' and the '''Desert of Desolation'', once the center of the ancient empire of [[Imaskar]].

popup.title: Bandit Wastes
popup.description: An expanse of barrens or badlands between [[Lapaliiya]] and [[Halruaa]], home to monsters, among them were [[giant ants]], which dug a warren of tunnels beneath the barrens.

popup.title: Calim Desert
popup.description: The rocky desert on the coast of [[Calimshan]], formed by an epic magical war between two [[genie]]s, the [[djinni]] [[Calim]] and [[efreeti]] [[Memnon]].

popup.title: Teshyllal Wastes
popup.description: The desert wastelands surrounding the ruins of the ancient city of [[Teshyll]].

popup.title: Hordelands
popup.description: '''The Endless Wastes''' or '''Taan''', the land of  horsemen tribes, most notably the [[Tuigan]]s.

popup.title: Singing Sands
popup.description: The site of the [[1194 DR]] event known as the [[Battle of the Singing Sands]] between [[Aglarond]] and the [[Red Wizards of Thay]].

popup.title: Stonelands
popup.description: A rocky and hilly region of harsh beauty marked by knife-edged ridges, deep ravines, caverns, and overhangs.

popup.title: Anauroch
popup.description: Also known as '''The Great Sand Sea''', a magical desert in [[northern Faerûn]] created my a calamity in [[10 DR]].

popup.title: The Cold Field
popup.description: A flat, treeless moor permanently scarred by [[dragon's breath]] and haunted by [[ghost]]s of long-dead soldiers.

popup.title: The Burn
popup.description: Once a [[goblin]]-infested forest, incinerated with magic into a stretch of barren land between the [[Shaddan Hills]] to the [[Hunters' Hills]].

popup.title: The Quarter of Emptiness
popup.description: The last remnant of the [[Anauroch]] in the century after the [[Spellplague]]. The region returned to its former state in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Moander's Footstep
popup.description: The region of the dessert that housed a river and a swamp in the century that followed the [[Spellplague]] and reverted to its desert state in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Tortured Land
popup.description: A barren area in the northernmost [[Moonsea]] region, inhabited by [[Ondonti]] [[orc]]s who followed the teachings of of [[Eldath]], the Goddess of Peace and Quiet Places.

popup.title: Nsi Wastes
popup.description: A stretch of blighted poisonous jungle and cut down trees.

popup.title: The Fallen Lands
popup.description: A barren area of the [[Savage Frontier]], home to many monsters and even more mysteries. In the mid-to-late 14{{th}} century [[DR]], it was beset with ''[[dead-magic]]'' zones, areas of ''[[wild magic]]'' and random discharges of ''[[witchfire]]''.

popup.title: Valley of Embers
popup.description: A barren lowland covered in lava flows that spewed out of the [[Peaks of Flame]], the sky above was choked with clouds of ash and dotted with blazing cinders.

popup.title: Valley of Lost Honor
popup.description: Once the last refuge of the [[Eshowe]] tribe before they were wiped out by [[Ras Nsi]].

popup.title: Land of Ash and Smoke
popup.description: The area of the jungle, scorched by volcanic activity, south of the [[Peaks of Flame]].

popup.title: Blackfeather Barrens
popup.description: The area of the [[Beastlands]] that stretched between the [[Toadsquat Mountains]] and the [[Curna Mountains]].

popup.title: Cinnabar Wastes
popup.description: A region of cold and arid badlands in northeast [[Vaasa]] named for the reddish color of the local rock formations.

popup.title: At'ar's Looking Glass
popup.description: A sweltering and uniquely hazardous stretch of desert – a flat "sea" of small, multi-color polished stones that absorbed more heat from the sun than any other surface in [[Anauroch]].

popup.title: Bowl of Loneliness
popup.description: A great dune field located in [[the Sword]], between the oases of [[El Rahalat]] and [[El Ma'ra]].

popup.title: The Saiyaddar
popup.description: A region of [[Anauroch]] used as the "hunting grounds" of the [[Bedine]] [[human]]s.

popup.title: The Sword
popup.description: One of the three major regions of [[Anauroch]] – a hot, sandy region most thought of when someone mentioned the Great Desert.

popup.title: Hills of Scent
popup.description: A large grouping of sandy stone hills found in [[the Sword]] region of [[Anauroch]].

popup.title: The Plain of Standing Stones
popup.description: The central region of [[Anauroch]] where winds abraded jagged rocks that stood in the middle of a sea of gravel.
